state_ownership.active_screen: WindowCoordinator.active selects the only full NotchView; other enabled panels render compactOnly with fixed geometryOverride.
state_ownership.context_menu: AppMenuCommands shared wording/shortcuts; NotchView contextMenu renders disabled version, Settings…, separator, Quit Valora; actions reuse showSettings/quit.
state_ownership.drag_ownership: AppModel.pointerInteractionActive is set by progress/volume drag begin and cleared on end/cancel; WindowCoordinator refuses activation while set.
state_ownership.expanded: AppModel.presentation.expanded remains the one visual transition for the active panel; switching active collapses first, then activates the new panel.
state_ownership.hit_testing: DisplayDescriptor frames (including negative origins) + per-screen geometry/localContour; containsMouse is a pure static seam tested with injected coordinates.
state_ownership.hover_cancel: Per-panel DispatchWorkItem is generation-guarded and cancelled on pointer exit, activation, display selection/place, disable/hide and deinit.
state_ownership.multi_display_peek: AppModel.allowsMultiDisplayDynamic is true only for multiple enabled all-display panels; it permits the existing peek path on an external pill without changing single-display policy.
state_ownership.peek_target: MediaController.updateSongPeek -> AppModel.trackChangedHandler -> WindowCoordinator.handleTrackChanged -> peekTarget (active pointer, pointer screen, then active fallback).
state_ownership.per_screen: WindowCoordinator.ScreenPanel owns its DisplayDescriptor, NSPanel, NotchGeometry, pointerInside, pendingHover and hoverGeneration.
state_ownership.shared_media: AppModel.media/title/artist/album/artwork/playing/elapsed/duration/output; MediaController and SystemMediaSource remain single instances.

user_authorization: User approved: all enabled displays may be operated; dynamic playback presentation follows the screen being operated. Not claimed as the original Alcove default.
